name: double-tap-button
title: Double Tap Button
description: A destructive action that needs two presses: the first arms it with a draining fuse, the second inside the window confirms. Waiting or blur disarms it.

props.name: children
props.description: Text in the resting state, e.g. Delete project.

props.name: armedLabel
props.description: Text while armed, waiting for the second press.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called on the second press, inside the arming window.

props.name: window
props.description: Milliseconds the button stays armed before it falls back to rest.
